message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a grey background and a red border on the left and bottom. At the top, the large grey word "TEMPO" is displayed. Above it, three headlines in white text are separated by diagonal lines: "ADRIANUS MELIALA: SAYA KO!", "REKENING GENDUT GUBERNUR SULAWESI TENGGARA", and "AKHIR PAHIT JERO WACIK". Below "TEMPO" is the date "8-14 SEPTEMBER 2014".

Centered white text reads "AIB POLRI DI NEGERI TETANGGA" followed by "Dua polisi Indonesia diduga terlibat sindikat narkotik. Tempo melacak sampai Malaysia."

The central image is a stylized illustration of a man in a dark blue police uniform. He is shown from the chest up, with his arms raised, holding a black police cap with gold and red accents above his head with both hands. His face and head are composed of a white, grainy, powder-like substance, creating a semi-transparent effect. White powder clouds surround his head and hands. The uniform has gold stars on the shoulder straps and a gold badge on the chest.

In the bottom left, text indicates "RP 35.000", a website, a magazine title, an ISSN, and a barcode.
